blocks.text: Schools in Champlain Heights include Champlain Heights Annex (7835 Champlain Cres) and Champlain Heights Community Elementary (6955 Frontenac St). This is not a complete list of the schools nearby.

Living near a school does not mean a place at it. Your child's school comes from the district's catchment boundaries, and those change, so confirm the address with the district before you write an offer.
Source: BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list (2025/26, updated July 2026) and the Province's post-secondary locations list. Neighbourhood placement is from our own area research.

faq.q: Is Champlain Heights its own City of Vancouver neighbourhood?
faq.a: Not one of the 22 distinct local areas — the City lists "Champlain Heights" as a recognised smaller area inside the Killarney local area, in the southeastern corner of the city bordering Burnaby and the Fraser River.

faq.q: Which schools are in and near Champlain Heights?
faq.a: Champlain Heights Elementary, 6955 Frontenac Street, is inside the neighbourhood; Cook (3340 East 54th Avenue), MacCorkindale (6100 Battison Street) and Weir (2900 East 44th Avenue) elementaries and Killarney Secondary (6454 Killarney Street) serve the wider Killarney area — catchments are address-based, so check the exact address in the VSB locator.

The Champlain Heights Branch library at 7110 Kerr Street is inside the neighbourhood, Killarney Community Centre (6260 Killarney Street) provides the indoor pool, ice rink and fitness centre, and Everett Crowley Park's 40 hectares of trails and off-leash area adjoin at 8200 Kerr Street.

faq.q: Is all of Champlain Heights freehold?
faq.a: No — the neighbourhood mixes freehold detached houses with strata townhouses / condos and leasehold complexes from its planned build-out; tenure and lease terms must be confirmed on title for the specific property.

faq.q: Is there a SkyTrain station in Champlain Heights?
faq.a: No — the area is bus-served, with route 49 on 49th Avenue to Metrotown Station and UBC, route 26 to Joyce Station, and route 100 on Marine Drive to 22nd Street Station.
